config.carrier: A34's grid to the field, with trace_writeoff on. No off arm: A34's off arm fed its instrument range and nothing here reads it

criteria.detail: Asserted every round in the loop, not checked afterwards: the claim total equals held plus parked to 1e-09 of the opening stock. Read back here: 1800 of 1800 cells close. **The counters do not enter this**: they record and the assertion is on the stock, so a counter that was wrong would not show up here and A35-2 is what covers that. State map: every cell closing -> PASS; any cell open -> FAIL, and nothing after this reads.
criteria.name: A35-1 the books close on every cell of this grid

criteria.detail: **Run, not argued, and the group that matters is the second one.** Every configuration is compared against network.py.expired_20260913_pre_A35 twice, once with ``trace_writeoff`` off and once with it on, over every field of the history plus the closing state plus the generator digest. **Off is the letter of rule 19 and it is nearly free to satisfy**, since a field nobody allocates cannot change anything; the group with the switch on is the one that can fail, because computing a counter can consume a random draw, alias an array, or read state after something has already moved it. Off also has to leave the four fields unallocated and on has to allocate all four, both checked per configuration. trace off: run, 193 configurations, 50 fields each, 0 differ; trace on: run, 193 configurations, 50 fields each, 0 differ.  State map: both groups run and nothing differing -> PASS; any field differing, the baseline missing, or either sha moved since the gate ran -> FAIL.
criteria.name: A35-2 rule 19: the counters do not change the run

criteria.detail: **A known answer with a name and a date, not a self-comparison.** A34 reported the firing rounds per shape on 2026-09-13 after a missing base subscript was corrected. This station runs the same grid with the counters on and recomputes them. Cells shared with A34's record: 900; cells where the count differs: 0. Recomputed medians over the live cells: holdings 98.0, equal 173.0, threshold 97.0. Per-head longer than pro rata in 233 cells, shorter in 0. **This criterion can fail three ways**: the counters perturbed the run (A35-2 would also fail), the grid does not line up with A34's, or the correction was itself wrong. State map: at least one shared cell and no count differing -> PASS; any count differing -> FAIL, and every reading after this is about a different grid from A34's.
criteria.name: A35-3 A34's firing rounds come back on this module

criteria.detail: Printed, not judged. What a shape aimed at the held side minus what left the accounts, measured off the accounts rather than read back from the branch that took it. Relative to what was aimed at, over the cells where the write-off fired: holdings: 238 cells fired, 0 of them leave a shortfall above the floor, relative max 0.0, relative median 0.0, absolute total at the median 0.0; equal: 238 cells fired, 234 of them leave a shortfall above the floor, relative max 0.608787, relative median 0.503056, absolute total at the median 640.161231; threshold: 238 cells fired, 0 of them leave a shortfall above the floor, relative max 0.0, relative median 0.0, absolute total at the median 0.0. **Pro rata and above-the-mean sit at the arithmetic floor and per head sits about thirteen orders of magnitude above it.** The two small figures print as 0.0 because this field carries six decimals; what they actually measure is near 1e-14 relative, which is a difference of two sums of order the claim stock and therefore arithmetic rather than a shortfall. **The residue is deliberately not recorded**: its last digits belong to the BLAS build and would surface as a false diff on the next machine, so what the record carries is whether the shortfall cleared the 1e-09 floor above. **Neither small figure is claimed as an exact zero.** **Why per head cannot avoid it and pro rata cannot incur it**: a per-head levy aims one share at every account holding anything, so an account holding less than that share pays what it has and the rest is not collected and not carried forward; pro rata aims a fraction of each account's own balance, which no account can fail to meet. Above-the-mean scales what it aims at down to what the excess can fund, so it does not cap per account either.
criteria.name: A35-4 what each shape failed to collect

criteria.detail: Printed, not judged. Paired within the cell, per head against pro rata, over the 238 cells where all three shapes fired. **Rank correlation, printed beside the object rather than tested against a line**: the extra rounds against the shortfall the cap left, 0.560849; the extra rounds against the extra accounts emptied, 0.03696. **The shortfall carries it and the paying set does not.** The two correlations differ by a factor of 15, and the paying-set count says the same thing from the other side: the payers the levy could draw on at its last firing round are fewer than at its first in 55 of the 238 cells. **Emptying an account and keeping it empty are two different things**, and this grid does the first constantly without doing the second: a per-head levy empties accounts every round and they receive inflow again before the next one, so the count of emptyings is large while the number of payers at the levy barely moves. A35-6 has that as a factorisation. **The third shape says neither candidate is necessary**: above-the-mean differs from pro rata in 211 of 238 cells, and in 211 of those the shortfall is below the 1e-09 floor and no account was emptied at all, so a firing-round difference exists with neither candidate present. **That difference has a third channel and it is the amount rather than the shape**: above-the-mean destroys 0.982512 times as much per firing round as pro rata at the median, so the ratio it fires on falls faster. **What is claimed and what is not**: the large effect, per head against pro rata, is claimed for the shortfall; the small one, above-the-mean against pro rata, is claimed for neither candidate and is registered open.
criteria.name: A35-5 which of the two candidates carries the prolongation

criteria.detail: Printed, not judged. Per round, per shape, over the cells where the write-off fired. holdings: 238 cells fired; the per-head share ends at 0.878184 times where it started, which factors into a stock term of 0.86491 and a paying-set term of 1.0; payers go from a median of 125.0 to 125.0 with a minimum of 125.0 and rise again in 45 rounds in all; accounts emptied 0.0 per cell at the median, over 0.0 rounds; equal: 238 cells fired; the per-head share ends at 0.971977 times where it started, which factors into a stock term of 0.959537 and a paying-set term of 1.0; payers go from a median of 125.0 to 125.0 with a minimum of 125.0 and rise again in 185 rounds in all; accounts emptied 11245.0 per cell at the median, over 148.0 rounds; threshold: 238 cells fired; the per-head share ends at 0.861011 times where it started, which factors into a stock term of 0.847945 and a paying-set term of 1.0; payers go from a median of 125.0 to 125.0 with a minimum of 125.0 and rise again in 110 rounds in all; accounts emptied 0.0 per cell at the median, over 0.0 rounds. **The factorisation is arithmetic and not a fitted split**, and it is exact to 4.44e-16 across every cell because both factors are recovered from the same two counters. **The stock it uses is the one the levy was aimed at, not the one at the close of the round**: those differ by 0.070053 at the median, since everything else in the round runs between them, and using the closing figure put a four per cent error into the split on the first attempt. **The registered prediction was that the share rises monotonically under a per-head levy, and both halves of it are wrong.** The share is the rate times the held stock over the payers; the write-off is destroying the stock, so the numerator falls under every shape, and the prediction was that a per-head levy makes the denominator fall too. **The paying-set term above says how far it actually falls, and at the median the answer is not at all.** Accounts are emptied in their thousands and they are payers again by the next levy, so the count the share divides by ends where it started. **Read the paying-set term, not the share**: it is one under any shape that cannot empty an account, and on this grid it is one under the shape that can, too. **A drained account is also not gone**: it receives inflow next round and is a payer again, which is why the payer count recovers rather than only falling and why the accounts-emptied count over a run exceeds the number of accounts. Pro rata and above-the-mean empty nobody, and that half is structural: a fraction of a balance cannot reach zero and an excess above the mean is never the whole of an account.
criteria.name: A35-6 does the paying set shrink and the per-head share rise

criteria.detail: Printed, not judged. The same grid at 300 and 600 rounds. **The count is a lower bound and the paired ratio is the reading.** Counts, medians over the cells that fired: 300 rounds: holdings 98.0, equal 173.0, threshold 97.0; 600 rounds: holdings 198.0, equal 298.5, threshold 197.0. **Every shape's median moved, and roughly in proportion to the horizon**, so none of them is an estimate of anything: holdings, equal, threshold. Cells still firing in the last round: 300 rounds: holdings 126 of 238, equal 160 of 238, threshold 137 of 238; 600 rounds: holdings 133 of 244, equal 166 of 244, threshold 131 of 244, which is why. Fraction of rounds in which it fired, which divides the horizon out: 300 rounds: holdings 0.326667, equal 0.576667, threshold 0.323333; 600 rounds: holdings 0.33, equal 0.4975, threshold 0.328333. **Within-cell ratio of per head to pro rata, which censors both sides the same way and is what survives: 1.510204 at 300 rounds and 1.505051 at 600, a drift of 0.3%.** The direction counts survive too: per head longer than pro rata in 233 of 238 cells at the short horizon and 236 of 244 at the long one, shorter in 0 and 0. **What this costs**: every place the count was written as a median is a lower bound and has to say so, A34's write-up included. **What it leaves standing**: the comparison, which is what the claim was about. State map: a statistic unchanged across the doubling -> a reading; changed -> a lower bound, and every write-up of it is corrected.
criteria.name: A35-7 whether the firing-round count is a reading or a horizon

criteria.detail: Printed. Every cell's per-round counters are summarised on its row in the record: what was aimed at and what was left uncollected, the payers the levy could draw on at the first and last firing round and the minimum, whether that count ever rose, the accounts emptied and in how many rounds, and the per-head share at the first and last firing round with the count of rounds it fell. 1800 rows and 600 cells. Per shape, over the cells that fired: holdings: firing rounds median 198.0, destroyed median 1974.989355, uncollected median 0.0, payers last median 125.0; equal: firing rounds median 295.0, destroyed median 2067.492855, uncollected median 705.036947, payers last median 125.0; threshold: firing rounds median 176.0, destroyed median 1783.394748, uncollected median 0.0, payers last median 125.0.
